message: No detected input validation: The /predict endpoint accepts any string via Pydantic's BaseModel but performs no validation on length, content, or range of req.text or req.key beyond basic type checking.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data and model checkpoints are fetched from Yandex Cloud S3 URLs and HuggingFace Hub without any checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned commit/revision.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only calls dropna() on the dataframe; there is no validation of label values, distribution checks, or label-noise detection tools applied before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: Beyond dropping fully-null rows with dropna(), the code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The checkpoint is loaded directly from a public URL via `RegressionBert.load_from_checkpoint(CHECKPOINT)` and the BERT model is loaded with `AutoModel.from_pretrained(BERT)` without any hash verification, signature check, or pinned revision.
No detected label distribution validation: The dataset is loaded and split with no checks on label distribution, class balance, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a standard Adam optimizer with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus or TF Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial attack/robustness testing framework anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The validation split is derived from the same dataset object with no held-out test set, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and only a single metric (val_loss via L1Loss) is logged, providing no meaningful protection against metric manipulation.
No detected output bounds checks: The prediction result is returned directly after tolist() with no NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds on the model's numeric outputs.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the model processes text input, it is a regression BERT (not a generative LLM), and there are no input filtering, content moderation, or injection-detection mechanisms in the inference path.
